title: Elbow
description: This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel. Player has elbow.
body:
This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel.
You need "elbow room" to build. This mod prevents you from placing blocks if you are standing too close to the target location. You must step back and give yourself proper spacing to place any block.
